object_description: five-building campus ensemble around a central square
design_condition: Five buildings occupy the planning perimeter to complete the city block, respond to neighboring building heights, and form a central campus square connected by internal alleys and a boulevard.

positive.statement: The clear and comprehensible setting of the five buildings is based on a sensitive analysis of the prevailing context.
The passage and central internal square support the campus idea and create high-quality additional open space.
The individual buildings and their assigned uses are organized and structured in a comprehensible manner.
The supporting structure has a very high proportion of wood and is carefully processed.
The facade is carefully and precisely crafted.

negative.statement: The flexibility of the floors is not optimal and is relatively limited, particularly because of the deep floor plans and wide supports.
The assignment of faculties to individual buildings is not completely convincing operationally and does not promote cross-disciplinary work.
It is very doubtful whether the underground transport network works geometrically and it will likely require more space.
The facade appears more like an office or administrative building than a technical university.
After the second stage, the open space loses some of its generosity and power.
